name: Political instability
value: No G20 collapse; Indonesia VP post vacant
summary: Indonesia's vice-president resigned on 12 Nov; parliament picks a successor within 60 days. No G20 collapse
state: Indonesia's Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted his resignation on 12 Nov after courts ruled his education documents did not meet election requirements, and President Prabowo accepted it; the People's Consultative Assembly must elect a successor within 60 days (Al Jazeera). The House pressed ahead with an impeachment inquiry on 12 Nov (Jakarta Post). This is a constitutional succession rather than a government collapse, and no G20 coup, contested election or government collapse was found as of 17 Nov.
for_you: Little direct effect for most readers. Travellers to Indonesia can follow FCDO travel advice, which covers protests and wildfire haze.
